journal: PhD thesis, University of Calgary (PRISM repository)
needs_pass2_reason: Text layer clean; every cell of the four extracted tables matched the page image (pdf pages 86, 87, 122, 138, 176 viewed).
experimental_method: Tunable diode laser absorption spectroscopy (TDLAS) of water in the liquid acid-gas / liquid propane phase, equilibrated with hydrate in a cold loop; hydrate annealed at 238 K, then stepped in temperature.
uncertainties_stated: Pressure +-0.001 MPa; temperature +-0.1 K (stability); water content +-20 ppm for CO2 (Table 3.3), 12 ppm (95%) for C3H8 (Table 6.1), 2% relative with triplicate std. dev. 25 ppm for H2S and mixtures (Table 5.2, A.3.1); TDLAS manufacturer accuracy 2% relative.
quality_remarks: Footnote letters a and b are swapped relative to the column headers in Table 3.3 and 5.2 (a text refers to temperature, b to pressure). In the text of A.3 the second mixture is called 55.5% H2S + 45.5% CO2 but table label gives 44.5% CO2 (table value kept). Basis of 'ppm' (mole vs volume) not stated; written as yH2O. Temperature scale not stated. Calc and residual columns are the author's model, not data.
duplication_check_vs_alassi_2022: Compared ONLY with extract/10.1016_j.jngse.2022.104732 tables 12-14 (liquid propane water content at 8.274 MPa, 276.15-313.15 K, QCM and SiO2 hygrometer, ppmV). Adeniyi Table 6.1 (liquid propane + hydrate, TDLAS, 242-276 K, 1.1-40 MPa) shares no T-p points and no values with them (e.g. Alassi 276.15 K / 8.274 MPa = 112 ppmV vs Adeniyi 276.10-276.12 K at 2.55, 10.0 MPa = 110, 105 ppm). These are NOT the same data: all four extracted thesis tables carry new measured data.

extraction_notes: Printed page numbers are pdf page minus 20. Table 3.3 is CO2(l) + hydrate (7.9-50 MPa, 238-278 K); Table 5.2 H2S(l) + hydrate (mole fraction); Table A.3.1 H2S + CO2 mixtures + hydrate. Isotherm blocks separated by blank lines are not labelled in print; no group rows needed. H2S and H2S-CO2 are outside the seven-gas list but kept per SPEC v2.1.
sanity_checks: Pressure/temperature ranges as stated in text; y_H2O increases with T at fixed pressure in all tables; slight pressure dependence as the text states; no replicate rows flagged.
